```yaml
name: Execute pre-commit on PR

on:
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [precommit-run]

jobs:
  precommit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    env:
      PAT: ${{ secrets.PRECOMMIT_PAT }}
      BRANCH: ${{ github.event.client_payload.branch }}
      HEAD_OWNER: ${{ github.event.client_payload.head_owner }}
      HEAD_REPO: ${{ github.event.client_payload.head_repo }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PR branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.BRANCH }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set remote URL with PAT
        run: |
          git remote set-url origin https://x-access-token:${PAT}@github.com/${HEAD_OWNER}/${HEAD_REPO}.git

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install pre-commit
        run: pip install pre-commit

      - name: Run pre-commit hooks
        run: pre-commit run --all-files

      - name: Check for changes
        id: check_changes
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "no_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "no_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.no_changes == 'false'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "pre-commit: automated formatting fixes"
          git push origin HEAD:${BRANCH}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PRECOMMIT_PAT }}
```
